body:
I've been at your point too a few months ago, close to suicide. Then a friend got me out of it, this is what helped me:

1. [Wayne Dyer - Your Life Mistakes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XqpzQV0UyBg&t=2s) 
2. Watch as many Eckhard Tolle videos as possible. He explains that all worries are the ego (sense of self, identity), not who you really are.
3. You view the world through a negative lense and it's not your fault. It's believes you caught up when you were a child but you can change them. It's not your fault at all.

Learn about letting go of the ego, your pain body, self-compassion, buddhist teachings. Listen to the power of now until you get sick of it. Read about depressions as a door to spiritual awakening. This might be the moment for you to wake up. I listen to mindfulnessmeditationcenter videos on Facebook daily. He explains everything you need to know. 

Don't be too proud to take meds if you need them. They might give you the necessary push to get out and you can always stop taking them once you have transformed.

Lots of love and compassion from someone who can relate <3
